data.body: **[P2] Validate the dependency contract users will deploy.** This conformance function retains `opentelemetry-sdk`, masking the `io.opentelemetry.sdk.*` classes required by the plugin-only layer, while the checked-in layer guidance says no additional OTel dependency is needed. A function following that guidance can fail dynamic provider loading. Either package the required runtime jars and remove this dependency, or update the user-facing installation documentation to require the matching OTel SDK and test exactly that documented application dependency set.
